name: estate-guard
description: Estate Planning & Legacy Protection for the Owens family. Tracks wills, trusts, beneficiary designations, life insurance, survivor benefits, and powers of attorney. Ensures Lindsey and the kids are protected if something happens to Tory. Triggers on: "Estate plan", "Will", "Life insurance", "Beneficiaries", "What happens if", "Legacy", "Survivor benefits", "Power of attorney", "Trust", "Estate check", "Beneficiary audit", "SGLI", "FSGLI", "Dependent education", "Chapter 35". The only estate plan that fails worse than a bad one is no plan at all.
